item.title: Atlanta Outpost Helps French Software Firm Reach $50M in Annual Recurring Revenue
item.description: Only a small fraction of SaaS businesses ever reach $10 million in ARR. The percentage of those that reach $50 million? A tiny fraction of that. And that number may continue to shrink as many SaaS businesses confront new AI realities. But that $50 million revenue milestone is what SaaS communications company Ringover announced this week.
